scope: Captured walking, sitting and turning chains; CPU and Vulkan replay and independent feedback
rationale: 0.1 mm position and 0.01 degree rotation ceilings exceed measured FP32 cross-backend maxima of 0.00558 mm and 0.000827 degrees; the 0.0001 contact ceiling exceeds the measured 0.0000685 maximum. These are fixture regression limits, not a guarantee for arbitrary motions or acceptance of mixed-FP16 drift.
